pcs.pc_description: check and ensure materials are available (i.e.silver strips or pasta, wires, screwdriver, solder, wooden ash tray and cutters etc.,)as per the requirement of payal
ensure that the silver strips or wires are annealed, cleaned, lubricated and cut to desired length before press cutting or drawing
put and align die of design in the hand or power or automated press
cut the components like ghungroo halves (hemispheres), mati, kadi, akoda, other link and design components in different sizes and thickness using press machine, wire (sut) making machine
assemble and solder halves of ghungroo in different sizes and kadi using flux usually called as morchud or takankhaar
arrange different designs or combination of links of payal like rupali-koyna, gajashree-topi etc.,
assemble different link parts with help of mati( fine linking wire) and tools like plier, cutter etc.,
arrange multiple lines of assembled links, ghungroos of different designs/ sizes in wooden ash tray and solder all of them with small flame torch, flux etc. to make a payal
pickle and clean payal with diluted sulphuric acid, water
check the strip before punching in press for any defects like cracks or bad surface etc.,
check soldered joints and compare the final payal weight, design, shape and flow with the original sketch or order detail
maintain proper record of metal weight received prior to the assembly and final weight of the payal
ensure that the target is achieved as per order
